title: ITVX / Social promotion cards
slide_intent: Carry expressive type into a reusable social-card structure, because viewers need to recognize the same service across different situations.
strategic_value: This approach can strengthen continuity between campaign recognition and service use.
demonstration: Three social-post mockups sit across a yellow field. The centre card combines repeated FRESH lettering with a cut-out performer; adjacent cards carry different programme imagery.
practical_value: Carry expressive type into a reusable social-card structure.

content_islands.name: Centre card
content_islands.spec: Repeated headline type sits behind a performer.

content_islands.name: Side cards
content_islands.spec: Partial cards demonstrate different programme treatments within the same platform frame.
